messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: onboarding for Atlas (acct: AT-409) goes live tomorrow. Need a short prefill/jitter checklist we can give SEs and PMs. Key asks: minimize cold tokens, capture renewal-risk signal, and validate streaming fallbacks. Anyone have a pared-down checklist?
aj_platform: I can draft. Quick Q: do we prefer client-side jitter (staggered prefill) or server-side warm-pool? both have tradeoffs.
joah_sre: If low-latency is top priority -> warm-pool + short TTL on edge cache. If cost-sensitive -> client jitter + adaptive batching. Also add circuit-breaker for failed prefill attempts :warning:
emily_se: From field: customers hate visible 'initial lag' even if it's a few seconds. Recommend: 1) immediate token prefill on consent 2) 2s client jitter window 3) fallback banner copy. I'll add copy snippets.
aj_platform: Draft checklist (short):
```
- Grant prefill opt-in flag
- Start 2s jittered prefill (client)
- Kick server warm-pool for high-tier tenants
- Edge cache TTL 60s (stateless prompts)
- Capture `renewal_signal` tag on failures
- Streaming fallback: send partials every 200ms
```
Drop this to SEs?
james_cs: :thumbsup: Love it. Add 'post-onboard 24h health ping' to capture usage + NPS. Also capture a 'renewal-risk' label when activity < X.
maria_cs: Perfect. Can someone add the NPS ping text? Also need a simple asklist for PMs: What to check before go-live (rate limits, model pin, key rotation).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [auto] Prefill flag AT-409:enabled by maria_cs
joah_sre: PM asklist (short):
- Confirm model pin version
- Verify rate-limit quotas for tenant
- Confirm KMS key rotation schedule
- Ensure canary route for lower-tier fallback

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll combine into one-pager for SEs and post in #cs-resources. Tagging @emily_se for copy. :sparkles:
